prompt: Choose the best sentence for the blank.
promptZh: 請選出最適合填入空格的句子。

options.text: Refer every gray amount to accounting, even if it has no receipt number.
options.zh: 每筆灰色金額都交給會計，即使沒有收據編號。
options.whyZh: 前段明說無編號金額只供參考，不是實際交易。

options.text: Escalate whenever two lines show the same address, even when each belongs to a different box.
options.zh: 兩筆明細的地址相同就轉請會計處理，即使各自對應不同箱子。
options.whyZh: 下一句明說不同箱同址本身不是升級處理的理由。

options.text: Skip the packing list if both amounts have receipt numbers.
options.zh: 只要兩筆金額都有收據編號，就不用看裝箱清單。
options.whyZh: 有編號只證明有實際交易；本段明確要求比對裝箱清單。

options.text: Escalate if both numbered delivery lines refer to the same packing entry.
options.zh: 若兩筆有編號的運費明細都對應同一筆裝箱紀錄，就轉請會計處理。
options.whyZh: 這句同時要求有交易編號與兩筆對到同一裝箱紀錄，和後句不同箱無須升級一致。

explanationZh: 這句同時要求有交易編號與兩筆對到同一裝箱紀錄，和後句不同箱無須升級一致。
evidence: A gray amount with a receipt number […] belongs to an actual transaction. […] The packing list has one entry per box. Compare it with the order history before escalating. Escalate if both numbered delivery lines refer to the same packing entry. Two separate boxes going to the same address are not, by themselves, a reason to escalate.

vocabulary.note: packing entry 指裝箱清單上對應一個包裹的紀錄。

difficultyRationale: 跨段辨認實際交易、再用裝箱紀錄粒度排除同址／不同箱。
